systems.system: Base de Dados do Recenseamento Eleitoral (BDRE)
systems.owner: Central electoral support service, supervised by the Comissão Nacional de Eleições
systems.tiers: Electoral registration commissions (comissões de recenseamento), with online access at consultation or operation level

note: A law, which places nothing: Lei 22/VII/2008 gives electoral registration commissions online access to the electoral database over the state network, but the commissions are electoral bodies and the text puts no câmara municipal or municipal office on the network. Local authorities appear only in the unrelated fees law (Lei 21/VII/2008). Capture is an excerpt.
